cards: Andy must hold bread and a cookie. Bread uses 3 wheat at a crafting table. Cookies use 2 wheat and 1 cocoa bean at a crafting table. Andy must also hold a hay bale (hay_block), made with 9 wheat in a crafting table.
Jill must hold paper and a golden apple. Paper uses 3 sugar cane. A golden apple uses 1 apple and 8 gold ingots at a crafting table. Jill must also hold sugar, made from 1 sugar cane.

Andy must hold bread and a pumpkin pie. Bread uses 3 wheat at a crafting table. A pumpkin pie uses pumpkin, egg, and sugar, one of each. Andy must also hold a hay bale (hay_block), made with 9 wheat in a crafting table.
Jill must hold sugar and a golden apple. Sugar uses 1 sugar cane. A golden apple uses 1 apple and 8 gold ingots at a crafting table. Jill must also hold paper, made from 3 sugar cane.

Andy must hold orange dye and pink dye. Orange dye uses red dye and yellow dye. Pink dye uses red dye and white dye. The exact item names are orange_dye and pink_dye. Andy must also hold purple dye, made from red and blue dye.
Jill must hold paper and a golden apple. Paper uses 3 sugar cane. A golden apple uses 1 apple and 8 gold ingots at a crafting table. Jill must also hold sugar, made from 1 sugar cane.
